name: Ke-Wen Kong
evidence: Name renders as 'Kewen Kong' on the paper; co-author of LLM-GLOBE (arXiv:2411.06032), Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University (affiliation confirmed by a web search snippet). GitHub code search for "Kewen Kong" returned 8 hits, all arXiv daily-listing mirrors, reference lists and a Semantic Scholar authorId fixture - no email anywhere. The project repo https://github.com/raovish6/LLM-GLOBE prints no author contacts and has no CITATION.cff. A search of files containing 'Karinshak' (the lead author) surfaced only one unrelated address (a Georgia state senator). No verbatim address for this person could be retrieved.
